dockerfile:
FROM python:3.9-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
CMD ["python"]
explanation: Generated requirements.txt with Conan 2.0+ for compatibility with the conan-io/conan-center-index repository. The Dockerfile uses python:3.9-slim as base, installs dependencies from requirements.txt, and sets a default Python shell command for execution.
